verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents Slack-native incident operation. Runbooks automatically create incident Slack channels and assign the opener as Commander. Within the incident channel, `/fh` triggers runbooks and `/fh update` posts updates that flow to the internal status page. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of declaring a new incident directly from a Slack command, any Microsoft Teams support, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Slack workflow.
